name: demo-telco-prefix-history
select: _timestamp, if(toString(_json.type) = 'W', 'withdrawal', 'announcement') AS update, toString(_json.attrs.target_prefix) AS prefix, concat(splitByChar('-', toString(_json.attrs.source_id))[2], ' (rrc', splitByChar('-', toString(_json.attrs.source_id))[1], ')') AS peer, arrayStringConcat(dynamicElement(_json.attrs.path, 'Array(Nullable(Int64))'), ' ') AS as_path, toString(_json.attrs.community) AS communities
